Situation: Corvale General holds 364 tablets of clopidogrel bisulfate 300 mg (26.2 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 23 tablets of the same presentation (8.9 days on hand). All current stock carries the Apotex Corp. label with NDC 60505-3532-5.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include clopidogrel bisulfate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Lakeside's supply is below two weeks. General can spare inventory without dropping below a two-week threshold. Alternative manufacturers are available for purchase but none are on the FDA shortage list and their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 14 tablets of 300 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Ascend Laboratories, LLC if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from AvPAK if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No other actions at this time.
